summary: Algoma Steel filed a Form 6-K with a press release updating the status of an unplanned outage at its Lake Superior Power generating facility. The company resumed electric arc furnace production on August 29, 2026 under interim arrangements with the Ontario electricity system operator. It is pursuing repair or replacement of the affected turbine, working with GE. This is an operational update, not a special situation; no transaction, strategic review, or extraordinary corporate event is involved.
